answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 24358 Country: India Title: Kindly let me know that wether parents can give the interest amount to their children or not. Question: AssalamAlaikum, kindly let me know that wether parents can give the interest amount to their children or not. AllahHafiz Answer ID: 24358 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1713/1713/M=1431) Interest money is impure. As far as taqwa (piety) is concerned, one should not give such money to one's own children. However, if the children are very poor and needy, then it is allowable to give them interest money. له مال فيه شبهة إذا تصدق على أبيه يكفيه ذلك ولا يشترط التصدق على الأجنبي . (هنديه 349/5) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
